findings.message: Entry param page (filter:caixaDespesasPendentes, persisted) has no state whose source is entry.params.page. Added public state 'page' (number | null), persisted in localStorage, used as the page of qryInicio and written when a pager loads a page (not on append).
public page is not declared by the defs; the shared added it so the pages can drive the page (a draft, a setter, a selection or a filter state).
